description: This file contains unit tests for the CampaignTracker class in the SuiteCRM project. It tests object instantiation, persistence (save/delete), and some behavior methods of the CampaignTracker bean.

classes.name: CampaignTrackerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing CampaignTracker functionality within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including global variable and default configuration.

methods.name: testCampaignTracker
methods.description: Tests instantiation and basic properties of CampaignTracker object.

methods.description: Tests saving a CampaignTracker record and deleting it.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
